interface.longDescription: Choose one of six teams to start with, or set up all six at your own pace. Selecting teams configures their named ZAIP subagents in your project. Get one-off plans in chat. Keep reusable decisions in the relevant area and choose Word for deliverables that need it. Reconcile existing document pairs when editing them. Use 205 skills and 23 specialist perspectives to plan campaigns, measure growth, develop software and run operations with the connections available in your client.
defaultPrompt: Help me choose a team and set up this project for my company.
Check what changed in the sales playbook and reconcile Word and Markdown.
